description: This file defines the JsonApi class within the SuiteCRM API, implementing response formatting and logging interfaces. It includes a version constant, a logger property, and methods for setting the logger, retrieving a schema path, and generating a basic JSON API response with version info.

classes.name: JsonApi
classes.description: Represents a JSON API response handler with versioning, logging capability, and schema path retrieval.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a logger instance on the JsonApi object.

methods.name: getSchemaPath
methods.description: Returns the file path to the JSON schema.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Returns an array representing the JSON API response with version information.
